title: Who decarbonised: within/reallocation/entry/exit accounting

source.request: Who decarbonised Indonesian manufacturing: firms becoming cleaner or production reallocating toward cleaner firms?
source.strategy:
Accounting decomposition, bukan causal regression. 
FHK decomposition + Melitz–Polanec dynamic decomposition. 
Within + reallocation + entry + exit.

question: Did manufacturing become cleaner because factories improved, or because production moved toward cleaner factories?
rationale: Explain aggregate environmental intensity with exact accounting using the single implementation owned by D4.
scope: Full exact Word row, interpreted through repository minimum checks and current owner full-plan ning/full-row acceptance gates. All analysis below is planned, not executed.
unit_of_analysis: Verified plant at two calendar endpoints and accounting interval×group×measure×component; frame evidence distinguishes observed entry/exit from business birth/death.

target_estimands.name: Primary requested target
target_estimands.formula: A_t = sum_i s_it a_it = sum_i C_it / sum_i V_it, s_it=V_it/sum_i V_it, a_it=C_it/V_it; Delta A = W+B+X+EN+EX

symbols.i: a verified establishment, never a row-number or artificial linkage
symbols.V: value added deflated with a certified appropriate price index; any single-output-deflator approximation is named
symbols.Y: gross output deflated with its certified output-price index
symbols.E: scope-defined verified physical energy in GJ; incomplete observed subtotals are separately named
symbols.C: scope-defined verified CO2 in metric tonnes; not automatically all greenhouse gases
symbols.L: workers under an annually verified employment definition
symbols.g: verified treatment-entry cohort in calendar years
symbols.S: a verified trade, ownership, industry, or survival state; unknown is retained as unknown
symbols.A_t: aggregate intensity on the exact denominator universe
symbols.s_it: plant denominator share in the full eligible population

target_estimands.interpretation: The weighted plant intensity equals the aggregate ratio on the exact same positive-denominator universe. FHK within, between, cross, entry and exit terms sum to the observed change; MP provides a separate exact decomposition.
target_estimands.limits: This is accounting, not a causal regression. Frame movement, reporting attrition and industry/trade reclassification can mimic economic entry or exit. A negative intensity change is improvement under this orientation.

target_estimands.name: Exact FHK identity
target_estimands.formula: Delta A = sum_S s_i0 Delta a_i + sum_S (a_i0-A0) Delta s_i + sum_S Delta s_i Delta a_i + sum_EN s_i1(a_i1-A0) - sum_EX s_i0(a_i0-A0)

symbols.S: establishments observed in both endpoint universes
symbols.a_it: the plant intensity with the named denominator
symbols.s_it: plant share of the full endpoint denominator

target_estimands.interpretation: Five signed terms add to the observed change; a negative contribution lowers intensity. The exit term includes its displayed minus sign.
target_estimands.limits: Observed entry/exit can include reporting or frame movements; none of these terms is a causal regression coefficient.

target_estimands.name: Exact dynamic Melitz–Polanec identity
target_estimands.formula: Delta A = Delta A_S + s_EN,1(A_EN,1-A_S,1) - s_EX,0(A_EX,0-A_S,0); A_S,t = mean_S(a_it) + sum_S (s_it/s_S,t - 1/n_S)(a_it-mean_S(a_it))

symbols.A_S,t: survivor-only weighted intensity with survivor denominator shares renormalized to one
symbols.A_EN,1: entrant-only weighted intensity at the end
symbols.A_EX,0: exit-only weighted intensity at the start
symbols.s_EN,1: entrants’ share of the full end-year denominator
symbols.s_EX,0: exits’ share of the full start-year denominator

target_estimands.interpretation: Survivor change is separated into average-plant change and allocation within survivors; entry and exit are compared with the survivor reference at the matching endpoint.
target_estimands.limits: An empty survivor set makes this MP representation unavailable. Do not replace its reference means with FHK’s start aggregate.

entrypoint_contract.restart: Each edge writes an atomic output only after its checks. Restart by unchanged input/code hash; discard neither failed-run evidence nor unknown cells. Parent launcher stops on a blocking failure.
entrypoint_contract.offline_dependencies: Pinned Stata 17-compatible commands/ado files and bibliography/source receipts, resolved before execution; no automatic package down load during run. entrypoint_contract.estimated_cost_basis: Estimate after certified slim inputs and exact model-grid count are frozen. One source projection reused; no repeated 950 MB loads per outcome. Dry-run logs record cells, available RAM and expected iterations; never invent a completion time.
entrypoint_contract.branch_dispatch: The primary do-file accepts an explicit branch and resolves only that branch’s field, source and state prerequisites. finite_model_grid.combination_rule: Primary outcomes run under the registered primary method for each relevant exposure and supported declared calendar/horizon. Secondary outcomes run under that same primary method only. Each sensitivity changes exactly its named design decision and runs primary outcomes only, except explicitly registered component-identity checks. Legacy, switching-block, policy-specific, acquisition-era and accounting branches use their own compatible population/window; never take a blind Cartesian product.
finite_model_grid.selection_rule: Freeze model_id manifest before execution. Persist every intended cell including source_blocked, unsupported, non converged and omit ted terms. No outcome/covariate/threshold selection by significance.
finite_model_grid.multiple_testing: No statistical testing of finite-population accounting contributions. Primary C/V, all intervals, aggregate population, both methods. Other measures are supplementary. Classification and grouping variants are explicit additions.
finite_model_grid.secondary_testing: No hypothesis tests or conventional p-values. Observed-sample totals only; design-based intervals require an independently certified sampling design and a frozen amendment.
finite_model_grid.policy_for_unavailable_cells: No coefficient or zero is fabricated. The requested primary branch remains incomplete, even if supplementary supported descriptions exist.

exact_dimensions.primary_family: No statistical testing of finite-population accounting contributions. Primary C/V, all intervals, aggregate population, both methods. Other measures are supplementary. Classification and grouping variants are explicit additions.
exact_dimensions.group_rule: Survivors and exits use start-year group. Entrants have no observed start group and therefore use an explicit entrant-unclassified bucket unless an independent pre-start classification is verified. An end-year assigned entrant group is a separate current-membership decomposition with an explicit mover audit; never pretend it was baseline observed.
exact_dimensions.zero_change_threshold: Show contribution percentages only if abs(Delta A)>1e-8*max(1,abs(A0),abs(A1)); otherwise report native signed contributions and percentage unavailable. Always display offsetting components.

finite_model_grid.unavailable_hypothesis_rule: The planned hypothesis count remains fixed. Compute Holm over the fixed family with unavailable hypotheses treated conservatively as p=1 internally; publish their p-value as unavailable, never as a computed result. No significance-selected deletion. If a simultaneous band needs a fully supported profile, publish the supported band scope and all missing profile cells.
finite_model_grid.summary_rule: A fixed-window summary requires every declared constituent coefficient and its joint covariance. If any is unavailable, the registered summary is unavailable. Available-cell averages may appear only as a separately named diagnostic with the changed weights; they do not replace the primary summary.
